values.note: ReserveOhio, Turkey Creek Campground: site without electric $25 ($21 off-peak, Nov and Jan nights read), electric $35 ($31 off-peak), the same on a Saturday. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee. The full-hookup surcharge is the separate Ohio River Campground: $65, $55 off-peak.

hookups.source: https://ohiordr.usedirect.com/Ohiordr/rdr/ search/grid + search/details (Turkey Creek electric sites: Amps 30), read 2026-10-31. Ohio River Campground's 30/50 full hookups are at the separate camp

values.note: Turkey Creek: 86 electric, 21 non-electric; some non-electric sites are tent-only by terrain, 8 electric and 2 non-electric are under 23 ft. All Back In. Ohio River Campground adds 78 full hookup.

sites.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/shawnee-state-park-campground ('86 Electric sites', '21 Non-electric sites') + https://ohiordr.usedirect.com/Ohiordr/rdr/ search/grid + search/details (Driveway length 20-52 ft), read 2026-10-31

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/shawnee-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + https://ohiordr.usedirect.com/Ohiordr/rdr/ search/grid + search/details (MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-31

note: Turkey Creek Campground: heavily wooded, off State Route 125 near Roosevelt Lake. Off-peak (Nov 1-Apr 1) the dump station has no water; a fill station is behind the Camp Store. --Claude
summary: Changed: base 25 -> 21 off-peak, added 30A, 107 sites, 52 ft, facilities, 14-night max. Confirmed $25/$35 and usedirect. SPLIT flag: Ohio River Campground, 78 full-hookup sites 8 km away. Phone flag.
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE: ODNR says 'Shawnee State Park offers two different campgrounds'. This entry and pin are Turkey Creek. The Ohio River Campground (78 full-hookup sites, 30/50 amp, 47-130 ft, 20 pull-through, 58 back-in, $65, $55 off-peak, ReserveOhio facility 845, accessed from US Route 52 near the Marina) is 8.2 km away with its own entrance and check-in. Centroid 38.68386,-83.10448. No other DB entry covers it. Imagery there is out of date and shows a golf course, so the sites plot on fairways; the Ohio River isn't beside them (over 600 m to the SE), so don't assume water. Check-in (740) 858-6681 or (740) 858-4491. It would be its own add under the curation doc; the $65 is a state rate.
PHONE BLANK: Turkey Creek Camp Store/Check-in (740) 858-4561 on ODNR's page.

Pin OK: 215 m from the electric sites' centroid at 38.72890,-83.18187. Waterfront 'not waterfront' holds: heavily wooded and no claim of water on the page. Horse camp at Bear Lake is separate, run by Shawnee State Forest. No closure notice. Website could use the campground page https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/shawnee-state-park-campground.
